questions.text: What should the brightness be after reset?
questions.reason: LEDs visibly on but not glaring; shows PWM is working.
questions.answer: 0x40. CTRL resets with DUTY_SRC = 0, so brightness comes from DUTY, which resets to 0x40.
questions.evidence:
- {offset: 0x01, name: DUTY,    access: RW, reset: 0x40,   bits: "[7:0] PWM duty when DUTY_SRC = 0; [31:8] read 0"}
    - {offset: 0x02, name: CTRL,    access: RW, reset: 0x2,    bits: "[0] DUTY_SRC (1 = switches SW[7:0]); [1] DISPLAY_EN; [31:2] read 0"}

questions.text: Which brightness source is selected after reset?
questions.reason: Deterministic for scripted tests regardless of switch positions.

questions.text: Are LEDs and display enabled after reset?
questions.reason: User wants to see it working on the board immediately.

questions.text: What happens if up and down are pressed in the same clock cycle?
questions.default: They cancel; centre clear has top priority
questions.reason: Symmetric and predictable; clear is the strongest intent.
questions.answer: Up acts; down is ignored. Clear has higher priority than up if pressed on the same clock.
questions.evidence: If several presses land on the same clock, only the highest priority acts - clear, then up, then down.

questions.reason: Spec says one press changes the count by exactly one.

questions.text: How wide are the press counters, and do they wrap or saturate?
questions.reason: Ample for tests; wrapping is cheapest and matches the main counter.
questions.answer: Each of the up, down, and clear press counters is 8 bits wide and wraps at 256; saturation and PRESS_CLR are not specified.
questions.evidence: - {offset: 0x04, name: PRESSES, access: RO, reset: 0,      bits: "[7:0] up presses, [15:8] down, [23:16] clear; each wraps at 256"}

questions.answer: 8-bit resolution, with a 1024-clock period (PWM phase advances every 4 clocks), for approximately 97.7 kHz at 100 MHz—not a 256-clock period.
questions.evidence: - A phase counter (8 bits) advances once every PWM_PRESCALE clocks and wraps at 256.

questions.reason: Simple p < brightness compare; difference is invisible.
questions.answer: No. Brightness 0xFF is on 255/256 of the time, not fully on.
questions.evidence: - DUTY_EFF = 0 is fully off; 255 is on 255/256 of the time. Brightness is linear in DUTY_EFF (no gamma).

questions.text: Should the 7-seg display also be dimmed by the brightness?
questions.reason: Spec only asks for LED dimming.

questions.text: Should a host write to COUNT be counted as a press?
questions.reason: Press counters record physical button presses only.
questions.answer: No. A host write to COUNT is not counted as a press.
questions.evidence: A shell write to COUNT on the same clock as a press wins; the press still counts in PRESSES.
